scope: Local functional and scoped manual layout verification. Publication NOT VERIFIED. Clipboard/download and composition use isolated simulations; not an all-browser or screen-reader certification.

checks: 69 exact-output transformation cases across all seven modes, Unicode, punctuation, whitespace, abbreviations and invalid input
20 additional statistics/long-input/limit logic tests; actual 100,000-unit results and oversized rejection
22 real Chromium DSL cases: all modes, live counters, switching, copy success/denial, UTF-8 download, clear, empty input, safe rendering, stale results, keyboard and 320/375/768/1440px overflow

9 extended real Chromium cases: full/oversized and emoji limits, immediate invalidation, delayed copy, safe filename/UTF-8/object-URL revocation, keyboard, simulated composition and transport/storage calls
Manual review of rendered 1440px desktop and 375px mobile screenshots from the byte-identical generated source; labels, selected mode, panes, feedback and readable layout reviewed

limitations: Native language-neutral casing may expand code points; no locale-specific editorial, surname or proper-name detection
Sentence abbreviation heuristics are deliberately limited; ambiguous sentence endings require review
Code-point and whitespace-token counts are not grapheme/linguistic segmentation
100,000 UTF-16 input units; native textareas use LF
External HTTP(S) blocked in headless tests; clipboard/download APIs and composition events simulated; no live publication or real OS clipboard certification
